oneLineZh: 以仁与忠恕贯通人伦，用礼乐与正名把君子修身接到德治秩序。
oneLineEn: Joins ren and reciprocity to human relations; ritual and name-correction link junzi cultivation to virtue-rule.
oneLineEs: Con ren (humanidad), el ritual (li) y el cultivo del junzi (hombre noble) sentó la tradición ético-política confuciana.

oneLineZh: 以无名之道说明生成根据，用无为少欲减少强制并暴露名言限度。
oneLineEn: Explains generation by the nameless Dao; wuwei and few desires reduce coercion and expose limits of fixed names.
oneLineEs: Abre el pensamiento taoísta mediante el Dao, el wuwei (no-acción) y la resistencia al orden coercitivo.

oneLineZh: 以逍遥无待求精神自由，用齐物与心斋松动是非名言与生死执著。
oneLineEn: Seeks free wandering without dependence; equalizing things and mind-fasting loosen rigid speech and death-fixation.
oneLineEs: Desarrolla una filosofía de la libertad a través del vagar libre (xiaoyao), la igualación de las cosas y el escepticismo lingüístico.

oneLineZh: 以兼爱与兴利除害重构伦理，并用尚贤尚同与天志建立公共规范。
oneLineEn: Recasts ethics as universal love and mutual benefit, grounding norms in merit, upward conformity, and Heaven's will.

oneLineZh: 以四端性善论证仁政王道，把民本与义利之辨置于政治正当性核心。
oneLineEn: Argues innate goodness via the four sprouts for humane government, centering the people and right versus profit.

oneLineZh: 主张性恶须以礼义之伪转化，用正名与礼法组织欲望与社会秩序。
oneLineEn: Bad nature needs ritual-and-right artifice; rectifying names and ritual-law order desire and social life.

oneLineZh: 以良知内在不假外求，用知行合一把格物改写为致良知于事事物物。
oneLineEn: Innate knowing needs no outer search; unity of knowing and acting rewrites ge-wu as extending liangzhi to things.

oneLineZh: 以格物穷理把天理化为可学工夫，并强调知行相须与君主正心治国。
oneLineEn: Investigation of things makes Heavenly principle learnable, joining knowledge-action with the ruler's rectified mind.
keywordsEn: Collected Commentaries on the Four Books

oneLineZh: 以白话文学与大胆假设小心求证，把容忍批评建成公共试错机制。
oneLineEn: Vernacular writing plus bold hypothesis and careful proof turns tolerance of criticism into public trial-and-error.

oneLineZh: 从意欲方向比较中西文化，主张以乡村伦理与教育重建中国社会秩序。
oneLineEn: Compares Chinese and Western cultures by directions of will, rebuilding social order through rural ethics and education.

oneLineZh: 以苦、缘起、无我和解脱道路重塑印度思想中关于生命、执著与自由的根本问题。
oneLineEn: Recast Indian thought on life, attachment, and freedom through dukkha, dependent origination, non-self, and liberation.
oneLineEs: Reformuló el pensamiento indio sobre la vida, el apego y la libertad mediante el dukkha (sufrimiento), el origen dependiente, el no-yo y el camino de la liberación.

oneLineZh: 以不害为伦理核心，用正见正知正行与多面论清除业力通向解脱。
oneLineEn: Makes non-harm the ethical core; right view, knowledge, and conduct with many-sidedness clear karma toward release.

oneLineZh: 以缘起即空破除诸法自性，在归谬论证中保全世俗约定与解脱可能。
oneLineEn: Dependent arising as emptiness dissolves own-being; reductio keeps conventional truth and a path to release intact.

oneLineZh: 以五蕴相续说明无我经验，并用阿赖耶识与三性解释表象与解脱。
oneLineEn: Five-aggregate continuity explains no-self; ālaya-vijñāna and three natures account for appearance and release.

oneLineZh: 以梵我同一与无明叠置解释束缚，主张解脱依赖知识而非行动积累。
oneLineEn: Brahman-ātman identity plus superimposition of ignorance explain bondage; release rests on knowledge, not action-heaps.

oneLineZh: 主张有属性的最高神统摄灵魂与世界，以虔信与皈依通向解脱亲近。
oneLineEn: A qualified supreme God encompasses souls and world; devotion and surrender open intimacy of liberation.

oneLineZh: 把宗教理解为有限自我在爱与创造中实现无限，并批判排他民族主义。
oneLineEn: Religion as the finite self realizing the infinite in love and creation, while criticizing exclusive nationalism.

oneLineZh: 以真理实验与非暴力把政治变成自我统治，并用建设性纲领改造社会。
oneLineEn: Experiments with truth and nonviolence turn politics into self-rule, reforming society through a constructive program.

oneLineZh: 揭开种姓的宗教权威结构，以社会民主与新佛教追求平等公民身份。
oneLineEn: Exposes caste's religious authority structure and seeks equal citizenship through social democracy and a new Buddhism.

oneLineZh: 拒绝宗派权威与既定道路，以无选择觉察拆解心理时间中的自我。
oneLineEn: Rejects sectarian authority and fixed paths; choiceless awareness dismantles the self built in psychological time.

oneLineZh: 以水为自然本原解释多样变化，标志从神话叙事转向一般自然原则。
oneLineEn: Water as nature's principle explains diverse change, marking the turn from mythic story to general natural principles.

oneLineZh: 以 logos 统摄流变与对立，要求灵魂按共同尺度而非私见生活。
oneLineEn: Logos governs flux and opposition; the soul must live by a common measure, not private opinion.

oneLineZh: 从是者不可非是推出生成与分裂不可能，并区分真理路与意见路。
oneLineEn: From what-is cannot not-be he bars generation and division, parting the way of truth from the way of opinion.

oneLineZh: 以无知之知开启对话审查，把德性知识与灵魂照料置于财富名誉之上。
oneLineEn: Knowledge of ignorance opens elenchus; knowledge of virtue and care of the soul rank above wealth and honor.

oneLineZh: 以理念与洞穴喻区分意见与知识，用灵魂三分与城邦正义互证秩序。
oneLineEn: Separates opinion from knowledge via Forms and the cave; tripartite soul and civic justice mirror each other as order.
oneLineEs: Su teoría de las Ideas y la República lo convierten en una de las fuentes centrales de la filosofía occidental.

oneLineZh: 以实体与四因解释事物，用中道与实践智慧把幸福定为合德的理性活动。
oneLineEn: Explains things by substance and four causes; mean and practical wisdom cast flourishing as virtuous rational activity.
oneLineEs: Construyó un marco filosófico sistemático en torno a la sustancia, la causa final y la ética de la virtud.

oneLineZh: 用原子论消除神意恐惧，以去除痛苦与心灵宁静定义成熟的快乐。
oneLineEn: Atomism dispels fear of divine will; freedom from pain and mental tranquility define mature pleasure.

oneLineZh: 以宇宙理性为生活规范，主张唯有德性是善并以同意管理表象冲动。
oneLineEn: Cosmic reason is the norm of life; only virtue is good, and assent manages impressions and impulse.

oneLineZh: 以太一流溢说明心智与灵魂层级，用美的观照与德性引导灵魂回归。
oneLineEn: The One's emanation explains levels of Intellect and Soul; contemplation of beauty and virtue guide the soul's return.

oneLineZh: 以数学天文与公共教学维系晚期古典哲学教育，并卷入城邦权力暴力。
oneLineEn: Math, astronomy, and public teaching sustained late classical philosophical education amid civic power and violence.

oneLineZh: 以意志背离解释恶的缺失，用恩典更新与两座城之爱划分历史秩序。
oneLineEn: Evil as privation from will's turning away; grace renews and two loves of two cities order history.

oneLineZh: 以命运之轮消解外物幸福幻觉，用永恒当下调和天意预知与自由选择。
oneLineEn: Fortune's wheel dissolves the illusion of outer happiness; the eternal present reconciles providence with free choice.

oneLineZh: 在信仰寻求理解中提出本体论论证，并以补赎论连接正义与怜悯。
oneLineEn: Faith seeking understanding yields the ontological argument and joins justice and mercy through satisfaction theory.
keywordsEn: That than which nothing greater can be thought

oneLineZh: 以自然理性五路通向上帝，并用本质存在之分与自然法约束政治法律。
oneLineEn: Natural reason's five ways lead to God; essence-existence distinction and natural law constrain politics and law.

oneLineZh: 以唯名论拒绝共相实体，用神的绝对能力松动形上必然，并论证教权可错有界。
oneLineEn: Nominalism rejects universal substances; divine absolute power loosens necessity and bounds fallible church authority.

oneLineZh: 以古典学问与《愚人颂》讽刺，推动福音式内在虔敬与有限自由意志。
oneLineEn: Classical learning and The Praise of Folly advance inward evangelical piety and limited free will via satire.

oneLineZh: 把政治判断从道德劝诫中剥离，以 virtù 与共和冲突解释权力与自由。
oneLineEn: Detaches political judgment from moral preaching, explaining power and liberty through virtù and republican conflict.

oneLineZh: 以随笔自我书写把怀疑变为生活节制，在死亡意识中训练判断。
oneLineEn: Essayistic self-writing turns doubt into temperate living and trains judgment under the awareness of death.

oneLineZh: 以四偶像清理认识偏误，用有序归纳与实验把知识变成发现程序。
oneLineEn: Clears cognitive bias via the four idols; ordered induction and experiment make knowledge a discovery procedure.

oneLineZh: 从平等脆弱与互不信任推出自然状态，以契约与主权集中换取和平。
oneLineEn: Equal vulnerability and distrust yield the state of nature; covenant and concentrated sovereignty purchase peace.

oneLineZh: 以方法论怀疑确立我思确定性，并用心物二元为清晰科学奠基。
oneLineEn: Methodic doubt secures the certainty of the cogito and mind-body dualism underwrites clear scientific knowledge.

oneLineZh: 以神即自然的实体一元论，用几何学方式阐明情感必然与自由。
oneLineEn: Substance monism of God-or-Nature uses geometric method to show the necessity of the affects and of freedom.

oneLineZh: 以经验观念论否定天赋观念，并用同意与自然权利限制政府权力。
oneLineEn: Empirical theory of ideas rejects innate ideas; consent and natural rights constrain governmental power.

oneLineZh: 以无窗单子与预定和谐解释个体实体，并用充足理由说明世界秩序。
oneLineEn: Windowless monads and pre-established harmony explain individual substances; sufficient reason accounts for world order.

oneLineZh: 把因果还原为恒常连接与习惯，以情感与同情重构道德与宗教审查。
oneLineEn: Reduces causation to constant conjunction and habit; rebuilds morals by sentiment and sympathy and probes religion.

oneLineZh: 以自然人假说批判文明不平等，用公意与人民主权重写政治合法性。
oneLineEn: The natural-man hypothesis critiques civilized inequality; general will and popular sovereignty rewrite legitimacy.

oneLineZh: 以先验形式说明经验知识何以可能，用定言命令与自律重设道德与自由。
oneLineEn: Shows how experience is possible via a priori forms; categorical imperative and autonomy reset morality and freedom.
oneLineEs: Mediante la filosofía crítica redefinió los límites del conocimiento, de la libertad y de la ley moral.

oneLineZh: 以否定与承认推动意识历史，把自由落实为伦理生活中的制度整体。
oneLineEn: Negation and recognition drive consciousness's history; freedom is realized as institutional ethical life as a whole.

oneLineZh: 以盲目意志解释世界本质与痛苦，在艺术静观与同情中寻找解脱。
oneLineEn: Blind will explains the world's essence and suffering; aesthetic contemplation and compassion offer paths of release.
keywordsEn: The World as Will and Representation

oneLineZh: 以审美伦理宗教阶段逼出个体选择，把信仰置于伦理普遍性之外。
oneLineEn: Aesthetic, ethical, and religious stages force individual choice; faith stands outside ethical universality.

oneLineZh: 以伤害原则捍卫个人自由，并把高质量幸福与代议制接入功利主义。
oneLineEn: The harm principle defends personal liberty and joins higher pleasures and representative government to utilitarianism.

oneLineZh: 从生产关系解释意识，以商品拜物教与剩余价值揭示资本主义剥削。
oneLineEn: Explains consciousness from production relations; commodity fetishism and surplus value expose capitalist exploitation.

oneLineZh: 以谱系学追问道德起源，在上帝之死后用权力意志与视角重估价值。
oneLineEn: Genealogy probes the origin of morals; after the death of God, will to power and perspective revalue all values.

oneLineZh: 以函数—自变量与意义/指称区分重建逻辑，推动算术的逻辑基础。
oneLineEn: Rebuilds logic via function-argument and sense/reference, advancing a logical foundation for arithmetic.

oneLineZh: 以意向性与现象学还原考察意识显现，并重提生活世界作为科学根基。
oneLineEn: Intentionality and phenomenological reduction examine how consciousness appears; the life-world grounds the sciences.

oneLineZh: 以绵延对抗空间化时间，用直觉把握生命创造与记忆的精神深度。
oneLineEn: Duration resists spatialized time; intuition grasps life's creativity and the spiritual depth of memory.

oneLineZh: 把知识视为探究工具与后果检验，主张民主是共享经验的生活方式。
oneLineEn: Knowledge is a tool of inquiry tested by consequences; democracy is a way of life of shared experience.
keywordsEn: Democracy as a way of life

oneLineZh: 前期以命题图像划界可说，后期以语言游戏与用法治疗哲学困惑。
oneLineEn: Early picture theory bounds the sayable; later language-games and use treat philosophical confusions.

oneLineZh: 以此在分析重提存在问题，以在世存在与向死而在开启本真可能。
oneLineEn: Dasein analysis reopens the question of Being; being-in-the-world and being-toward-death open authentic possibility.

oneLineZh: 用逻辑分析与摹状词理论澄清知识，并以可错性批判限制权力迷信。
oneLineEn: Logical analysis and the theory of descriptions clarify knowledge; fallibilism restrains superstitious faith in power.

oneLineZh: 以实际机缘与摄取替代实体，用过程哲学纠正科学抽象的错置具体性。
oneLineEn: Actual occasions and prehension replace substance; process philosophy corrects the fallacy of misplaced concreteness.

oneLineZh: 把传统哲学争论改写为语言框架选择，并以逻辑句法清除伪问题。
oneLineEn: Recasts traditional disputes as choices among linguistic frameworks; logical syntax clears pseudo-problems.

oneLineZh: 以行动与诞生性界定政治自由，并揭示极权如何摧毁共同世界与判断。
oneLineEn: Action and natality define political freedom and show how totalitarianism destroys the common world and judgment.

oneLineZh: 主张存在先于本质，以自为虚无与他者凝视把自由写成无法逃避的责任。
oneLineEn: Existence precedes essence; freedom as for-itself nothingness and the Other's gaze is inescapable responsibility.

oneLineZh: 指出女人是被历史制造的他者，在处境中追问如何实现具体自由。
oneLineEn: Woman is the Other produced by history; she asks how concrete freedom is realized within a given situation.

oneLineZh: 以身体图式与知觉场重写主体，使意义在具身表达与世界交织中生成。
oneLineEn: Body schema and perceptual field rewrite the subject; meaning arises in embodied expression intertwined with the world.

oneLineZh: 把荒诞定为意义要求与世界沉默的相遇，并以有限度反抗拒绝新压迫。
oneLineEn: Defines the absurd as demand for meaning meeting the world's silence; limited revolt refuses new forms of oppression.

oneLineZh: 以整体论消解分析综合二分，用量化承诺决定理论的本体论内容。
oneLineEn: Holism dissolves the analytic-synthetic divide; ontological commitments of a theory are fixed by its quantifiers.

oneLineZh: 以原初状态与无知之幕选择正义原则，用差异原则与公共理性协调自由平等。
oneLineEn: Uses veil of ignorance to pick justice principles; difference principle and public reason balance liberty and equality.
oneLineEs: Con la teoría de la justicia como equidad reconfiguró el marco problemático de la filosofía política contemporánea.

oneLineZh: 以权利侧约束论证最小国家，用资格正义反对模式化再分配终态。
oneLineEn: Side-constraint rights justify a minimal state; entitlement justice rejects patterned end-state redistribution.

oneLineZh: 用谱系学揭示知识与权力共构主体，以规训与自我技术分析现代治理。
oneLineEn: Genealogy shows knowledge-power co-forms the subject; discipline and techniques of the self map modern governmentality.

oneLineZh: 以延异与可重复书写瓦解在场中心，让解构介入正义与责任的决定。
oneLineEn: Différance and iterable writing unsettle presence-metaphysics; deconstruction enters justice and responsibility.

oneLineZh: 以交往理性对抗系统殖民，用公共商谈重建民主合法性与生活世界。
oneLineEn: Communicative reason resists system colonization; public discourse rebuilds democratic legitimacy and the life-world.

oneLineZh: 以利益平等考量扩展道德圈，要求富裕者以可计算效果回应远方苦难。
oneLineEn: Equal consideration of interests widens the moral circle; the affluent answer distant suffering with calculable effect.

oneLineZh: 以核心能力门槛衡量正义，并把情感评价接入对脆弱生命的尊严关怀。
oneLineEn: A threshold of central capabilities measures justice and joins evaluative emotions to care for vulnerable dignity.

oneLineZh: 以宇宙流溢秩序为城邦范型，主张哲学首领协调证明真理与宗教象征。
oneLineEn: Cosmic emanation orders the virtuous city; a philosophical ruler coordinates demonstrative truth and religious symbols.

oneLineZh: 以本质与存在之分为核心，用必然存在者与悬浮人论证支撑灵魂独立。
oneLineEn: Essence-existence distinction is central; the Necessary Existent and the floating man support the soul's independence.

oneLineZh: 限定哲学证明边界并批判必然因果，主张确信须经修行净化而获得。
oneLineEn: Limits philosophical proof and critiques necessary causality; certainty needs purification through spiritual practice.

oneLineZh: 捍卫亚里士多德与自然因果，主张证明与律法可借经文解释相互协调。
oneLineEn: Defends Aristotle and natural causality; demonstration and law can be coordinated through scriptural interpretation.

oneLineZh: 主张存在优先并有强弱层级，以实体运动与知识存在化贯通哲学灵修。
oneLineEn: Existence is prior and graded; substantial motion and knowledge-as-being join philosophy with spiritual practice.

oneLineZh: 用理性论证护持启示信仰，以创造论与诫命实践巩固共同体确信。
oneLineEn: Rational argument upholds revealed faith; creation doctrine and commandment practice strengthen communal certainty.

oneLineZh: 以否定神学约束对神的言说，并让律法同时服务理智完善与政治秩序。
oneLineEn: Negative theology constrains speech about God; law serves both intellectual perfection and political order.

oneLineZh: 以我—你直接关系定义真实存在，把对话与共同体置于对象化生活之先。
oneLineEn: I-Thou direct relation defines real existence; dialogue and community precede objectifying I-It life.

oneLineZh: 主张他者面容先于总体化认识，把无限责任写成语言与伦理的起点。
oneLineEn: The face of the Other precedes totalizing knowledge; infinite responsibility starts language and ethics.

oneLineZh: 主张修证一如，以只管打坐与有时思想让佛性在当下实践中显现。
oneLineEn: Practice and realization are one; just sitting and being-time let Buddha-nature appear in present practice.
keywordsEn: Treasury of the True Dharma Eye

oneLineZh: 以纯粹经验先于主客分裂，用场所逻辑与绝对无重写自我与实在。
oneLineEn: Pure experience precedes subject-object split; logic of place and absolute nothing rewrite self and reality.

oneLineZh: 从人间双重结构出发重建伦理学，并以风土解释共同生活的历史形态。
oneLineEn: Rebuilds ethics from the dual structure of ningen and explains shared historical life through climate and culture.

oneLineZh: 以四端主理说明道德情感发动，用敬与圣学图示统一君主知行修养。
oneLineEn: Principle-led four sprouts explain moral emotion; reverence and the Ten Diagrams unify royal knowledge and practice.

oneLineZh: 强调理气不相离并在气质中成德，把圣学贯通为修身与经世改革。
oneLineEn: Principle and qi inseparable, virtue formed in temperament; sage learning joins cultivation with statecraft reform.

oneLineZh: 以群体凝聚力与文明条件重建史学方法，解释王朝由团结走向奢靡衰败。
oneLineEn: Rebuilds historiography via group solidarity and civilizational conditions, tracking dynasties from cohesion to decline.

oneLineZh: 把非洲人在欧洲的权利问题哲学化，并以心灵无感受性澄清心身功能区分。
oneLineEn: Philosophizes African rights in Europe and clarifies mind-body roles by denying sensation to the mind itself.

oneLineZh: 以概念去殖民释放非洲语言资源，并用共识民主替代对抗式多数决。
oneLineEn: Conceptual decolonization frees African linguistic resources; consensus democracy replaces adversarial majority rule.

oneLineZh: 以黑人性肯定被贬抑的文化形式，并把节奏与人文主义写入非洲社会主义。
oneLineEn: Négritude affirms devalued cultural forms and writes rhythm and humanism into African socialism.

oneLineZh: 反对把非洲哲学等同民族世界观，主张内生知识须经公开论证与检验。
oneLineEn: Rejects equating African philosophy with ethnic worldviews; endogenous knowledge must face public argument and test.

oneLineZh: 从殖民现代性背面重写哲学起点，以受害者生命与人民权力建构解放伦理。
oneLineEn: Rewrites philosophy from the underside of colonial modernity; victims' life and popular power build a liberation ethics.

oneLineZh: 把拉美边缘经验升为历史意识，以摆脱精神依附参与界定普遍性问题。
oneLineEn: Lifts Latin American marginal experience into historical consciousness to define universal problems free of dependency.

names.en: Sor Juana Ines de la Cruz

oneLineZh: 为女性求知与公共论辩辩护，并以巴洛克梦境诗学勘探有限理智的界限。
oneLineEn: Defends women's right to know and public debate; Baroque dream poetics probes the limits of finite intellect.

oneLineZh: 批判理性/自然的支配二元，以生态理性与被捕食经验瓦解人类例外论。
oneLineEn: Critiques the reason/nature dualism of domination; ecological reason and prey experience dismantle human exceptionalism.

oneLineZh: 把性别理解为规范重复的操演效果，并以脆弱生命开启承认与哀悼政治。
oneLineEn: Gender is the performative effect of reiterated norms; precarious life opens a politics of recognition and mourning.

oneLineZh: 从种族阶级性别交叉压迫出发，把越界教育与爱写成反支配的伦理实践。
oneLineEn: From intersecting race-class-gender oppression, engaged pedagogy and love become ethical practice against domination.

oneLineZh: 芝诺之后的斯多葛学派领袖，以《宙斯赞歌》和顺从宇宙理性的虔敬伦理著称。
oneLineEn: Stoic leader after Zeno, known for the Hymn to Zeus and a piety of assent to cosmic reason.
oneLineEs: Líder estoico tras Zenón, conocido por el Himno a Zeus y una ética de piedad que asiente a la razón cósmica.

oneLineZh: 系统化早期斯多葛逻辑、物理学和伦理学，使斯多葛主义成为严整哲学体系。
oneLineEn: Systematized early Stoic logic, physics, and ethics into a rigorous philosophical architecture.
oneLineEs: Sistematizó la lógica, la física y la ética estoicas tempranas en una arquitectura filosófica rigurosa.

oneLineZh: 犬儒学派代表人物，用贫穷、自足和公开挑衅把哲学变成生活批判。
oneLineEn: Cynic who made philosophy a life-critique through poverty, self-sufficiency, and public provocation.
oneLineEs: Cínico que convirtió la filosofía en crítica de la vida mediante la pobreza, la autosuficiencia y la provocación pública.

oneLineZh: 苏格拉底弟子，强调德性自足与艰苦训练，开启犬儒传统先驱脉络。
oneLineEn: Socratic disciple stressing self-sufficient virtue and hard training, a forerunner of the Cynic line.
oneLineEs: Discípulo socrático que enfatizó la virtud, la autosuficiencia y el entrenamiento duro; precursor clave del cinismo.

oneLineZh: 毕达哥拉斯传统把数、宇宙秩序、灵魂净化和共同体生活连接起来。
oneLineEn: The Pythagorean tradition linked number, cosmic order, soul purification, and communal life.
oneLineEs: La tradición pitagórica vinculó el número, el orden cósmico, la purificación del alma y la vida comunitaria.

oneLineZh: 米利都学派代表人物，以 apeiron、宇宙生成和自然化解释推进早期希腊哲学。
oneLineEn: Milesian thinker who advanced early Greek philosophy via the apeiron, cosmogenesis, and naturalistic explanation.
oneLineEs: Pensador milesio que impulsó la filosofía griega temprana mediante el ápeiron, la cosmogénesis y la explicación naturalista.

oneLineZh: 米利都学派哲人，以气、凝聚和稀薄化解释自然变化与宇宙结构。
oneLineEn: Milesian philosopher explaining natural change and cosmic structure via air, condensation, and rarefaction.
oneLineEs: Filósofo milesio que explicó el cambio natural y la estructura cósmica mediante el aire, la condensación y la rarefacción.

oneLineZh: 前苏格拉底诗哲，批判拟人神观，并提出关于神、自然和人类知识限度的早期反思。
oneLineEn: Presocratic poet-philosopher who criticized anthropomorphic gods and probed limits of human knowledge.
oneLineEs: Poeta-filósofo presocrático que criticó los dioses antropomorfos y planteó reflexiones tempranas sobre la divinidad, la naturaleza y los límites del conocimiento humano.

oneLineZh: 以四根、爱与争斗、宇宙循环和灵魂净化综合自然哲学与宗教伦理。
oneLineEn: Joined four roots, Love and Strife, cosmic cycles, and soul purification into natural philosophy and religious ethics.
oneLineEs: Unió las cuatro raíces, el Amor y la Discordia, los ciclos cósmicos y la purificación del alma en una filosofía natural y una ética religiosa.

oneLineZh: 把无限种子、万物相含和 Nous 引入自然哲学，并把爱奥尼亚自然解释带入雅典。
oneLineEn: Brought infinite seeds, mutual containment, and Nous into natural philosophy, carrying Ionian science into Athens.
oneLineEs: Introdujo en la filosofía natural las semillas infinitas, la contención mutua de todas las cosas y el Nous, llevando la explicación jonia a Atenas.

oneLineZh: 爱利亚学派哲人，以反多和反运动悖论捍卫巴门尼德式存在论。
oneLineEn: Eleatic thinker defending Parmenidean ontology with paradoxes against plurality and motion.
oneLineEs: Pensador eleático que defendió la ontología parmenídea con paradojas contra la pluralidad y el movimiento.

oneLineZh: 古代原子论代表人物，以原子与虚空解释自然，并提出感知、约定和安宁伦理问题。
oneLineEn: Ancient atomist explaining nature by atoms and void; raised issues of perception, convention, and ethical calm.
oneLineEs: Atomista antiguo que explicó la naturaleza mediante átomos y vacío, y planteó problemas de percepción, convención y calma ética.

oneLineZh: 智者运动代表人物，以“人是万物尺度”、德性教育和城邦实践理性著称。
oneLineEn: Leading sophist known for man as measure, virtue education, and civic practical reason.
oneLineEs: Sofista destacado, conocido por la tesis de que el hombre es la medida de todas las cosas, la educación en la virtud y la razón práctica cívica.

oneLineZh: 智者和修辞家，以激进的存在论论证、语言力量和说服技艺闻名。
oneLineEn: Sophist and rhetorician famed for radical ontological arguments, linguistic power, and the art of persuasion.
oneLineEs: Sofista y retórico famoso por argumentos ontológicos radicales, el poder del lenguaje y el arte de la persuasión.

oneLineZh: 皮浪主义源头人物，以悬置判断和心灵安宁的传统影响古代怀疑论。
oneLineEn: Founding figure of Pyrrhonism; suspension of judgment and mental calm shaped ancient skepticism.
oneLineEs: Figura fundadora del pirronismo; la suspensión del juicio y la calma mental moldearon el escepticismo antiguo.

oneLineZh: 亚里士多德继承者，扩展逍遥学派自然研究、植物学、性格描写和学术制度。
oneLineEn: Aristotle's successor expanding Peripatetic natural study, botany, character writing, and scholarly institutions.
oneLineEs: Sucesor de Aristóteles que amplió el estudio natural peripatético, la botánica, la descripción de caracteres y las instituciones académicas.

oneLineZh: 新学园怀疑主义代表，以反斯多葛知识论、概率性判断和罗马正义演说闻名。
oneLineEn: New Academy skeptic known for anti-Stoic epistemology, probable judgment, and Roman speeches on justice.
oneLineEs: Escéptico de la Nueva Academia, conocido por la epistemología antiestoica, el juicio probable y los discursos romanos sobre la justicia.

oneLineZh: 罗马政治家和哲学作者，把希腊哲学翻译进拉丁公共理性、共和伦理和自然法传统。
oneLineEn: Roman statesman-author who rendered Greek philosophy into Latin public reason, republican ethics, and natural law.
oneLineEs: Estadista y autor romano que tradujo la filosofía griega a la razón pública latina, la ética republicana y la tradición del derecho natural.

oneLineZh: 罗马伊壁鸠鲁主义诗人，以《物性论》用原子论治疗宗教恐惧和死亡恐惧。
oneLineEn: Roman Epicurean poet who, in De Rerum Natura, uses atomism to cure fear of the gods and of death.
oneLineEs: Poeta epicúreo romano que, en De rerum natura, usa el atomismo para curar el miedo a los dioses y a la muerte.

oneLineZh: 罗马斯多葛哲人和政治家，以书信、论怒、论仁慈和有限生命训练展开实践伦理。
oneLineEn: Roman Stoic statesman developing practical ethics in letters and essays on anger, clemency, and finite life.
oneLineEs: Estoico y estadista romano que desarrolló una ética práctica en cartas y ensayos sobre la ira, la clemencia y la finitud de la vida.

oneLineZh: 罗马斯多葛教师，以控制二分、同意训练和内在自由构成最具实践性的斯多葛手册传统。
oneLineEn: Roman Stoic teacher whose control dichotomy, assent training, and inner freedom define a practical handbook tradition.
oneLineEs: Maestro estoico romano cuya dicotomía del control, el entrenamiento del asentimiento y la libertad interior definen una tradición de manual práctico.

oneLineZh: 罗马皇帝和斯多葛作者，以《沉思录》把宇宙秩序、职责和自我训练结合起来。
oneLineEn: Roman emperor and Stoic author who, in the Meditations, joins cosmic order, duty, and self-discipline.
oneLineEs: Emperador romano y autor estoico que, en las Meditaciones, une el orden cósmico, el deber y la autodisciplina.

oneLineZh: 以知识学把康德批判哲学推进为从自我活动出发的自由体系。
oneLineEn: Advanced Kant's critical philosophy into a freedom system grounded in self-activity (Wissenschaftslehre).
oneLineEs: Mediante la Wissenschaftslehre (Doctrina de la ciencia) impulsó la filosofía crítica kantiana hacia un sistema de la libertad fundado en la autoactividad.

oneLineZh: 把自然、精神、艺术和自由组织为德国观念论内部最具生成性的体系实验。
oneLineEn: Organized nature, spirit, art, and freedom into German Idealism's most generative systematic experiments.
oneLineEs: Organizó la naturaleza, el espíritu, el arte y la libertad en los experimentos sistemáticos más generativos del idealismo alemán.

oneLineZh: 把黑格尔思辨神学倒转为人本学宗教批判，并成为马克思早期异化批判的近端入口。
oneLineEn: Inverted Hegelian theology into humanist critique of religion; a near gateway for Marx's early alienation critique.
oneLineEs: Invirtió la teología especulativa hegeliana en una crítica humanista de la religión, y fue puerta próxima de la temprana crítica marxiana de la alienación.

oneLineZh: 以人的脆弱、理性的限度和信仰赌注重塑早期现代基督教护教与存在论感受。
oneLineEn: Reshaped early modern Christian apologetics through human fragility, reason's limits, and the wager.
oneLineEs: Reformuló la apologética cristiana moderna temprana y el sentimiento existencial mediante la fragilidad humana, los límites de la razón y la apuesta de la fe.

oneLineZh: 以探究逻辑、实用主义准则和三元符号学建成美国实用主义的科学形态。
oneLineEn: Built scientific American pragmatism through inquiry logic, the pragmatic maxim, and triadic semiotics.
oneLineEs: Fundó el pragmatismo científico estadounidense mediante la lógica de la investigación, la máxima pragmática y la semiótica triádica.

oneLineZh: 把心理学、宗教经验、自由意志和实用主义真理观连接成经验多元论。
oneLineEn: Linked psychology, religious experience, free will, and pragmatic truth into radical empiricist pluralism.
oneLineEs: Vinculó psicología, experiencia religiosa, libre albedrío y verdad pragmática en un pluralismo empirista radical.

oneLineZh: 以双重意识、色线和废奴民主把种族经验推进为现代政治哲学和社会科学问题。
oneLineEn: Advanced racial experience as modern political philosophy via double consciousness, color line, and abolition democracy.
oneLineEs: Elevó la experiencia racial a problema de la filosofía política y las ciencias sociales modernas mediante la doble conciencia, la línea de color y la democracia abolicionista.

oneLineZh: 以伦理非自然主义、反观念论和常识实在论推动剑桥分析哲学成形。
oneLineEn: Helped form Cambridge analytic philosophy via ethical non-naturalism, anti-idealism, and common-sense realism.
oneLineEs: Contribuyó a formar la filosofía analítica de Cambridge mediante el no naturalismo ético, el antiidealismo y el realismo del sentido común.

oneLineZh: 以可证伪性、批判理性主义和开放社会论重塑二十世纪科学哲学与政治哲学。
oneLineEn: Remade 20th-c. philosophy of science and politics through falsifiability, critical rationalism, and the open society.
oneLineEs: Reformuló la filosofía de la ciencia y la política del siglo XX mediante la falseabilidad, el racionalismo crítico y la sociedad abierta.

oneLineZh: 以范式、常规科学和科学革命改写科学进步的历史哲学图景。
oneLineEn: Rewrote historical philosophy of scientific progress via paradigms, normal science, and scientific revolutions.
oneLineEs: Reescribió la filosofía histórica del progreso científico mediante paradigmas, ciencia normal y revoluciones científicas.

oneLineZh: 以精神科学、体验和理解理论把历史生命世界纳入哲学方法论。
oneLineEn: Brought the historical life-world into method via Geisteswissenschaften, Erlebnis, and Verstehen.
oneLineEs: Incorporó el mundo vital histórico a la metodología filosófica mediante las Geisteswissenschaften, el Erlebnis (vivencia) y el Verstehen (comprensión).

oneLineZh: 以效果历史、视域融合和语言性把解释学从方法论扩展为哲学本体论。
oneLineEn: Extended hermeneutics from method to ontology via effective history, fusion of horizons, and linguisticality.
oneLineEs: Extendió la hermenéutica del método a la ontología mediante la historia efectual, la fusión de horizontes y la lingüisticidad.

oneLineZh: 以生存哲学、界限处境和轴心时代思想连接克尔凯郭尔、尼采、海德格尔与阿伦特。
oneLineEn: Connected Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Heidegger, and Arendt through Existenz, limit situations, and the Axial Age.
oneLineEs: Conectó a Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Heidegger y Arendt mediante la filosofía de la Existenz, las situaciones límite y la Era Axial.

oneLineZh: 以《皮浪主义纲要》和《反学者》保存古代皮浪主义，并成为近代怀疑论复兴的文本枢纽。
oneLineEn: Preserved ancient Pyrrhonism in the Outlines and Against the Professors, a hub for early modern skeptical revival.
oneLineEs: Preservó el pirronismo antiguo en los Esbozos pirrónicos y Contra los profesores, nodo textual del renacimiento escéptico moderno temprano.

oneLineZh: 以存在单义性、形式区别和个体性理论构成阿奎那与奥卡姆之间的经院哲学关键中环。
oneLineEn: Scholastic link between Aquinas and Ockham via univocity of being, formal distinction, and individuation theory.
oneLineEs: Eslabón escolástico entre Tomás de Aquino y Ockham mediante la univocidad del ser, la distinción formal y la teoría de la individuación.

oneLineZh: 把希腊哲学翻译运动、第一哲学与伊斯兰一神论组织为阿拉伯哲学源头项目。
oneLineEn: Unites Greek translation, first philosophy, and Islamic monotheism as a founding Arabic philosophy project.
oneLineEs: Figura fundadora de la filosofía árabe que unió el movimiento de traducción griega, la primera filosofía y el monoteísmo islámico en un mismo proyecto.

oneLineZh: 以照明哲学改写伊本·西那、柏拉图主义光形而上学与临现知识路线。
oneLineEn: Recasts Ibn Sina, Platonic light metaphysics, and knowledge by presence as Illuminationist philosophy.
oneLineEs: Reformuló la tradición de Ibn Sina, la metafísica platónica de la luz y el conocimiento por presencia en la filosofía islámica iluminacionista.

oneLineZh: 以存在一性、完人、想象和神名理论塑造伊斯兰神秘形而上学，并深刻影响穆拉·萨德拉。
oneLineEn: Shaped Islamic mystical metaphysics via oneness of being, Perfect Human, imagination, and divine names.
oneLineEs: Configuró la metafísica mística islámica mediante la unidad del ser, el Hombre Perfecto, la imaginación y los nombres divinos, e influyó profundamente en Mullā Ṣadrā.

oneLineZh: 综合法、术、势与刑名之学，构成战国末期法家政治哲学的系统表达。
oneLineEn: Systematized late Warring States Legalism by uniting law, statecraft, power, and forms-and-names doctrine.
oneLineEs: Sistematizó el legalismo de finales de los Reinos Combatientes uniendo ley (fa), técnica de gobierno (shu), potencia posicional (shi) y la doctrina de formas y nombres.

oneLineZh: 以《坛经》中的顿悟、自性、无念和定慧不二塑造中国禅宗南宗经典形象。
oneLineEn: Shaped Southern Chan via sudden enlightenment, self-nature, no-thought, and nondual samadhi-prajna (Platform Sutra).
oneLineEs: Configuró el chan del Sur clásico mediante la iluminación súbita, la propia naturaleza, el no-pensamiento y la no dualidad de samādhi y prajñā (Sutra de la Plataforma).
keywordsEs: no dualidad de samādhi y prajñā

oneLineZh: 以太虚即气、民胞物与和成德工夫开出北宋道学气本论传统。
oneLineEn: Opened Northern Song qi ontology through Great Void as qi, all people as siblings, and virtue cultivation.
oneLineEs: Fundó la ontología del qi del daoxue del Song del Norte mediante el Gran Vacío como qi, la fraternidad con el pueblo y las cosas, y la práctica de la virtud.
keywordsEs: todos los pueblos como hermanos, todas las cosas como compañeras

oneLineZh: 以《集量论》建立佛教量论，把有效认知限定为现量与比量，并提出遮诠语言理论。
oneLineEn: Built Buddhist pramāṇa theory, limiting valid cognition to perception and inference, with apoha semantics.
oneLineEs: Fundó la teoría budista del pramāṇa, limitando la cognición válida a la percepción y la inferencia, con semántica del apoha (exclusión).

oneLineZh: 以女性理性可教论证公民平等，并延伸权利语言批判卢梭式性别教育。
oneLineEn: Argues civic equality from women's trainable reason and extends rights-language against Rousseau-style gender education.
oneLineEs: Criticó el orden de género ilustrado mediante la educación racional de las mujeres y la igualdad cívica.

oneLineZh: 以意向行动分析和现代道德哲学批判推动德性伦理复兴。
oneLineEn: Helped revive virtue ethics through analysis of intentional action and critique of modern moral philosophy.
oneLineEs: Impulsó el renacimiento de la ética de la virtud mediante el análisis de la acción intencional y la crítica de la filosofía moral moderna.

oneLineZh: 以《救赎之星》反击总体体系，并开出现代犹太对话哲学路线。
oneLineEn: Countered totalizing systems in The Star of Redemption and opened a modern Jewish dialogical philosophy.
oneLineEs: Con La estrella de la redención contrarrestó los sistemas totalizantes y abrió una vía de filosofía judía dialogal moderna.

oneLineZh: 以殖民心理分析和民族解放理论连接存在主义与后殖民思想。
oneLineEn: Linked existentialism and postcolonial thought through colonial psychology and theories of national liberation.
oneLineEs: Vinculó el existencialismo y el pensamiento poscolonial mediante la psicología colonial y las teorías de la liberación nacional.

oneLineZh: 以银行式教育批判揭示压迫再生产，用对话与意识化把教育写成解放实践。
oneLineEn: Shows how banking education reproduces oppression; dialogue and conscientization cast pedagogy as liberatory practice.
oneLineEs: Fundó la pedagogía crítica mediante el diálogo, la concientización y la crítica del modelo bancario de educación.

oneLineZh: 以批判理论和工具理性批判把马克思主义社会哲学改造为现代性诊断。
oneLineEn: Recast Marxist social philosophy as a diagnosis of modernity via critical theory and critique of instrumental reason.
oneLineEs: Reformuló la filosofía social marxista como diagnóstico de la modernidad mediante la teoría crítica y la crítica de la razón instrumental.

oneLineZh: 以否定辩证法、文化工业批判和现代主义美学揭示同一性思维中的社会支配。
oneLineEn: Exposed social domination in identity thinking via negative dialectics, culture industry, and modernist aesthetics.
oneLineEs: Reveló la dominación social en el pensamiento de la identidad mediante la dialéctica negativa, la industria cultural y la estética modernista.
keywordsEs: crítica del pensamiento de la identidad

oneLineZh: 以机械复制时代艺术、历史哲学和城市碎片书写重塑现代性批判的媒介维度。
oneLineEn: Remade media-critical modernity via art under mechanical reproduction, history, and urban fragment writing.
oneLineEs: Reformuló la dimensión mediática de la crítica de la modernidad mediante el arte en la era de la reproducción mecánica, la filosofía de la historia y la escritura fragmentaria urbana.

oneLineZh: 以马堡新康德主义和犹太理性宗教哲学连接康德传统与罗森茨维格。
oneLineEn: Linked Kantian tradition to Rosenzweig via Marburg Neo-Kantianism and Jewish rational religion philosophy.
oneLineEs: Vinculó la tradición kantiana con Rosenzweig mediante el neokantismo de Marburgo y la filosofía judía de la religión racional.

keywordsEn: birth of God in the soul
oneLineZh: 以离执、灵魂贫乏和神秘合一把经院神学推进到德语神秘主义核心。
oneLineEn: Pushed scholastic theology into German mysticism's core via detachment, poverty of spirit, and mystical union.
oneLineEs: Llevó la teología escolástica al núcleo del misticismo alemán mediante el desapego, la pobreza del espíritu y la unión mística.
keywordsEs: nacimiento de Dios en el alma

oneLineZh: 以有学问的无知、对立相合和无限者问题把中世纪神学推向文艺复兴形而上学。
oneLineEn: Moved medieval theology toward Renaissance metaphysics via learned ignorance, coincidence of opposites, and infinity.
oneLineEs: Desplazó la teología medieval hacia la metafísica renacentista mediante la docta ignorancia, la coincidencia de los opuestos y el problema del infinito.

oneLineZh: 以 verum factum 与《新科学》开出历史、法、神话与语言的自造世界。
oneLineEn: Opens history, law, myth, and language as human-made world via verum factum and the New Science.
oneLineEs: Abrió la historia, el derecho, el mito y el lenguaje como mundo hecho por el hombre mediante el principio verum factum y la Ciencia nueva.

oneLineZh: 以语言、民族精神和历史个体性批判抽象普遍主义，塑造德国历史主义与浪漫主义前史。
oneLineEn: Critiqued abstract universalism via language, national spirit, and historical individuality; shaped German historicism.
oneLineEs: Criticó el universalismo abstracto mediante el lenguaje, el espíritu nacional y la individualidad histórica, y moldeó el historicismo alemán y la prehistoria del romanticismo.

oneLineZh: 以自我哲学、伊斯兰思想重构和诗性政治想象回应现代性中的宗教与主体问题。
oneLineEn: Answered modernity's religion and self problems via self-philosophy, Islamic reconstruction, and poetic politics.
oneLineEs: Respondió a los problemas de religión y sujeto en la modernidad mediante una filosofía del self, la reconstrucción del pensamiento islámico y una imaginación político-poética.

oneLineZh: 以量论、因明和语言排除论把陈那之后的佛教认识论推向印度与藏传传统的高峰。
oneLineEn: Pushed post-Dignaga Buddhist epistemology to its Indo-Tibetan peak through pramana, logic, and apoha exclusion.
oneLineEs: Llevó la epistemología budista posterior a Dignāga a su cumbre indo-tibetana mediante el pramāṇa, la lógica y la exclusión lingüística (apoha).
